papers.title: Investigating the effect of acute consumption of kiwifruit on cognitive function using functional MRI
papers.reason: Human fMRI study using an N-back working memory task with cognitive-control activations, though the main contribution is a nutritional intervention rather than an executive-function model.

papers.title: Precision of sensory representations in cortex is indexed by alpha power and pupil dilation, and tracks the dynamics of correlated noise
papers.reason: Directly links EEG alpha power, pupil dilation, decoded representational precision, and working-memory performance in humans, providing mechanisms highly relevant to computational models of attention and memory.
